parsed.critic: C44 tests a low-cement high-fly-ash hypothesis that conflicts with the top predicted aliases, and tree disagreement of 8-11 MPa means any single recipe may underperform, while C01/C02 are near-duplicates of already strong observed ternary mixes so their marginal information is limited.
parsed.selection_rationale: C01, C02 and C05 have the highest predictions with plausible low water-to-binder chemistry, while C08 and C44 add evidence-linked exploration on slag-rich and fly-ash-rich binder designs so the batch tests both likely upside and hypothesis discrimination.
